subject: Your dog's 42-day surprise is ready
preview_text: We just unlocked something inside PupShape that nobody else has seen. Open before it goes live.
body_paragraphs: You've been crushing it for 42 days. But here's the thing—we've been building something in the background that's going to change how you and your dog approach weight loss. And you're the first to see it.

Starting next week, PupShape is rolling out a feature called 'The Daily Boost.' It's a 60-second morning check-in that adjusts your dog's meal plan and exercise for that day based on how they're feeling. If your pup is sluggish, it tweaks the calories. If they're bouncing off the walls, it adds a bonus walk. No more guessing. No more guilt.

We're giving you early access right now because you've earned it. Open your app, tap the 'Coming Soon' badge on your dashboard, and you'll see the exact release date plus a sneak peek of how it works. It's not live for anyone else yet.
Go see it before we flip the switch. P.S. The first 50 dogs to use The Daily Boost get a free month of Premium—and you're already on the list.
